capabilities: Wrap paragraphs or quotes into [!context] or [!context-short] blocks via commands
Unwrap the context block containing the cursor, restoring original quote markers
Render compact title-free blocks in Reading view and Live Preview
Adjust text size, padding, background strength and border strength in settings
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.9 or newer; installation is manual via npm build and copying files into the plugins folder. Disabling the plugin leaves valid callout Markdown that renders as a regular callout.
problem: Standard Obsidian callouts take up space with titles and padding, interrupting the flow of notes when you only want to add supporting details.
summary: Callout-based plugin that renders supplementary information as compact, title-free blocks with wrap and unwrap commands and adjustable appearance.
